name: KComposer
summary: The message box: one filled rounded object, auto-growing 17px textarea, a row of filled circles and pills (+, project chip, toggle chips) and the round ink send that becomes Stop.

project.description: A structured value { current, items, sub? }: the chip shows current, then sub dimmer (the agent or model).

gate.description: A message box: the send is aria-disabled while empty. A form's send stays pressable so an empty press says what's missing.

line.description: One line: the text and the send share a row.

error.description: A refusal: the words stay in the box.

menu.description: Extra + menu items { label, act } after attach, mention and project (a conversation's settings).

notes: Focus shows on the box (its edge turns ink-grey, 3:1 or better on the page), never the textarea.
On a phone the text is 17px and every control a filled 44px target; with the keyboard up a docked composer rides above it.
Every + menu item and the chip are buttons that open the kit menu (a bottom sheet on a phone); a toggle chip is a checkbox with role=switch.

do: A refused send keeps the words in the box with the reason under it.

examples.title: Ask the lead
examples.code: <KComposer id="ask" label="Ask the lead" value={text} onChange={setText} onSend={send} line />
